title: Release promotion: release-qualify --from-distill ties a vX.Y.Z tag to an accept-verified distilled candidate
goal: CEO: complete the workflow fully; GitHub is only storage; all merges happen in Susi; distinguish unqualified development integration from fully verified release promotion. release-qualify gains --from-distill <candidate> (and --verify-only): before any gate it proves from the committed receipt releases/distill/<name>.json that the candidate is accept-verified, complete (no rejected or deferred task), has no unadopted host-created commit, that every acceptance command passed, that its envelope commit is an ancestor of the release tree and that nothing but the version bump (the files of the v0.21.55 bump 47339995d, version-only line changes, plus one task record) lies between them. The qualification record then states source distill with a distillation block (candidate, receipt path and digest, envelope, composed commit and tree, included tasks, adopted host commits), or source snapshot; push-policy's tag check re-proves the block from the tagged tree. Records without source (v0.21.54, v0.21.55) stay valid.
host: CEO laptop, CachyOS Linux x86_64, Rust 1.99.0 (pinned); worktree on the local btrfs disk (CEO: no working directory on /mnt/shared)
acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test release_records --test architecture_tests --test orphan_sources --test lean_core_ceilings --test core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins --test no_github_coupling --test task_records
release-qualify --from-distill v0.21.56-distilled-rc13 v0.21.56 --verify-only in a throwaway clone (accepted), and on three tampered copies (refused)

results.release_qualify: release-qualify vX.Y.Z [--from-distill <candidate>] [--jobs N] [--verify-only]. --from-distill refuses before any gate unless verify_distilled_source proves the candidate from its committed receipt; the qualification record gains source (snapshot | distill) and, for distill, a distillation block (candidate, receipt_path, receipt_sha256, envelope_commit, base_commit, final_commit, final_tree, included_tasks, adopted_host_commits). Local refs susi-distill/<name>, susi-distill/legacy-release-<name> and release/<name> are cross-checked when present. --verify-only stops before the gates and writes nothing.
results.push_policy_tag_check: verify_tag (release_qualification.rs, used by push-policy) re-proves a distillation block from the tagged tree and requires it to equal what the receipt proves; source must be absent (legacy), snapshot without a block, or distill with one. v0.21.54 and v0.21.55 records stay valid.
results.bump_allowlist: the 12 files the v0.21.55 bump 47339995d modified, each changed only by old version -> new version on a line, plus at most one added .agents/tasks/<id>.json; nothing deleted
results.tests: new xtask/tests/distilled_release_promotion.rs 8/8 (real rc13 receipt digest vector; success path; 15 refusal cases; adopted host commit; receipt copied off the candidate line; built release-qualify --verify-only accepted/refused/corroboration; built push-policy admits and refuses distillation blocks, legacy and snapshot records); mutation checks: removing the tag-time re-proof, the bump check, the host-adoption check or the digest check each fails 1-2 of these tests. cargo test -p xtask: 27 binaries, 570 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. Root: release_records 5, architecture_tests 43, orphan_sources 3, lean_core_ceilings 2, core_docs_promise 5, no_github_coupling 5, task_records 3, all passed.
results.rc13_verify_only: throwaway clone at f938a6204 (refs/tags/susi-distill/legacy-release-v0.21.56-distilled-rc13) plus a 13-file 0.21.55 -> 0.21.56 bump mirroring 47339995d: exit 0, envelope f938a620413e, final_commit a5a94d3a18c8, receipt_sha256 d1419d39cfa2..., included T-AGYCLOUD-9, corroborated by susi-distill/v0.21.56-distilled-rc13, susi-distill/legacy-release-v0.21.56-distilled-rc13 and the local release branch; no target/ written, no tag. Refused (exit 1): receipt edited (digest does not re-compute), src/main.rs changed after the candidate (not part of a version bump), a dependency line added to crates/susi-gmcp/Cargo.toml (changes more than the version).

limitations: The receipt digest is integrity, not authenticity: anyone can write a self-consistent receipt. What it binds is that the promoted tree is exactly the receipt's composed tree plus the bump, and the full release gates still run on that tree.

Remote release branches are retired (T-CODEXSTORAGEONLY-1): the envelope commit reaches another host only through the vX.Y.Z tag's history or a susi-distill/legacy-release-<name> tag, so promotion normally runs where the candidate was distilled.
A future bump that touches an engine manifest outside BUMP_FILES is refused by name until the list is extended.
No v* tag was cut and no full release qualification was run (coordinator's step).
